WindowsApps.Uninstall.ConfirmStore: This will remove the Store app for your account.
WindowsApps.Uninstall.ConfirmWin32: This launches the program's own uninstaller, which may prompt for confirmation or elevation.
WindowsApps.RemoveRecord.ConfirmMessage: This entry looks like a leftover — its files and uninstaller can't be found. This removes the registry entry only; it does not delete any files.

WindowsApps.Advanced.Title: Advanced options
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.Title: Background apps permissions
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.Prompt: Let this app run in background
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.PowerOpt: Windows decides when the app may run in the background, and pauses it under battery saver.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.AlwaysDe: The app keeps working in the background even under battery saver — it will use more power.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.NeverDes: The app never runs in the background, so it can't sync, notify or update until you open it.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Background.SetFaile: Couldn't change the background permission for {0}.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Terminate.Label: Terminate
WindowsApps.Advanced.Terminate.Body: Immediately stop this app and its background processes. Anything it hasn't saved is lost.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Repair.Label: Repair
WindowsApps.Advanced.Repair.Body: Re-register the app from its own files. Your data stays where it is — try this first.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Reset.Label: Reset
WindowsApps.Advanced.Reset.Body: Delete the app's data, settings and sign-in details, then reinstall it from scratch. This can't be undone.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Reset.ConfirmMessag: This permanently deletes the app's data, settings and sign-in details, then reinstalls it from scratch. The app itself stays installed.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Move.Label: Move
WindowsApps.Advanced.Move.Body: Relocate this app's files to another drive. Its data and settings move with it.
WindowsApps.Advanced.Move.NoTarget: This PC has only one drive that can hold apps, so there's nowhere to move it.
WindowsApps.Advanced.AddOns.Title: App add-ons & downloadable content
WindowsApps.Advanced.AddOns.None: This app has no add-ons or downloadable content.
WindowsApps.Advanced.AddOns.ConfirmMessa: This removes the add-on only — {0} stays installed.
